pixel_description: Render only: human fingertip pressing top gray ridged circular disc (skin). Below disc a wide transparent wavy sheet (film). Below that ~40+ translucent white rounded-top pins (silicone pillar dielectric) in grid ~6x8 rows, sitting on top green wavy PCB with small chips at sides, dented down in middle under finger. Below that a second transparent wavy sheet. Below that ~17-20 rigid silver-black telescopic cylinders in single front row (multiple rows deep) standing between second green flat PCB below and the upper wavy PCB above. Below that second green flat PCB, a third lower green chip-covered PCB with black ICs and copper traces, with orange multi-line flexible ribbon (tail) exiting right rear in S-curve. Below that a solid light-gray rectangular block (core) then two vertical threaded screws with cross heads through to black base plate. All layers separated by air gaps in exploded view but stacked vertically in order: finger-skin-film-upper pins-upper board-membrane-lower pins-middle board-lower board-core-screws-base. Critical pillars: drawn as two distinct arrays, not one: upper soft translucent array compressed in center and connected only to upper PCB top, lower rigid metallic pin array connecting middle PCB to upper membrane, neither touching skin directly.

s1_differences: Sketch has skin full-width cap, single film, single soft-pillar array on flat electrode PCB, plus readout PCB, core, screws and rear tail. Render adds second rigid pin array, third PCB, second membrane, bends rigid PCB, shrinks skin to small disc, and misplaces Taxel Electrode Board callout onto pins.
s2_feedback: Exploded stack shows correct order skin-film-pillars-PCB-core-screws with rear tail exit and no interference; gaps are visualization separation, no design interference or unreachable assembly seen.
notes: Segmenter undercounts pillars and screws and mis-reports orientation due to exploded close-up; gaps are exploded-view style shared with sketch. Core faults are extra board, extra rigid pin array, bent electrode PCB, small isolated skin cap, and misplaced Taxel callout.
